title: Design System: YF Tracker - Private Venue Preview

shadows.name: modal-sheet
shadows.purpose: Observed modal depth only; ordinary exercise surfaces are flat.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: 16px translateY to zero, only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary Command
components.description: Confirmed sample finish saves all valid entered sets across current-workout/venue equipment drafts, including unticked sets; incomplete entries block save. Minimum height 44px.
components.css: .ds-command { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid #6877ec; border-radius:6px; background:var(--action); color:white; font:650 15px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-command:hover { background:#5969e5; } .ds-command:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-command:disabled { cursor:default; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Secondary Command
components.description: Keep a draft, cancel a guarded change/removal, or return to incomplete sets without deleting entered values, including RIR-only zero.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--text); font:650 15px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:transparent; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { cursor:default; opacity:.5; }

components.name: History Tool
components.description: Inline SVG action with tooltip and accessible name.
components.html: <button class="ds-tool" title="Exercise history" aria-label="Exercise history"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5M12 7v5l4 2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-tool { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:44px; height:44px; padding:0; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; } .ds-icon { width:19px; height:19px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-tool:hover { background:#252b36; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-tool:disabled { cursor:default; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Completed Set
components.description: Pressed completion marker; editing its sample set unmarks it.
components.html: <button class="ds-completed" aria-pressed="true" title="Complete sample set" aria-label="Complete sample set"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-completed { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:44px; height:44px; padding:0; border:1px solid #424b5c; border-radius:6px; background:#173b30; color:var(--green); cursor:pointer; } .ds-icon { width:19px; height:19px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-completed:hover { background:#173b30; } .ds-completed:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Load Field
components.description: Centered numeric entry; a placeholder is not a logged load. Unconfirmed setup/convention disables entry; confirming a different convention opens a venue-specific baseline without relabeling raw history.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" type="number" min="0" step="any" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="kg" aria-label="Sample set weight">
components.css: .ds-field { width:100%; min-width:0; min-height:44px; padding:8px 4px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px; background:#11141a; color:var(--text); caret-color:var(--accent); text-align:center; font:15px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:0; appearance:textfield; -moz-appearance:textfield; } .ds-field::-webkit-inner-spin-button { appearance:none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:#9ba4b5; opacity:1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-field:disabled { opacity:.75; } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color:#e89191; }

components.name: Exercise Item
components.description: Repeated framed exercise tool, not a floating page-section card.
components.css: .ds-exercise { padding:15px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); margin-bottom:12px; font:15px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-exercise h2 { margin:0; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.35; } .ds-exercise p { margin:5px 0 0; color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; } @media(max-width:440px) { .ds-exercise { padding:12px; } }

narrative.overview: This record describes only shipped `index.html`, within the scope of `PRODUCT.md` and `../../docs/tracker_preview_brief.md`. It extends the incumbent dark utilitarian identity, not a new world or public system. Background, exercise surface, text and action colors are inherited; muted text, accent and corners are preview refinements, not a tracker-wide migration.
keyCharacteristics: Compact set entry with explicit equipment/reference provenance.
Restrained indigo actions, neutral layering and green completion states.
Phone-first working column; secondary details in modal bottom sheets.

rules.name: The Provenance Rule
rules.body: Compact references show weight/reps without RIR, with source venue and explicit sample-visit labels. Detailed history and finish retain RIR. Local references prefer the selected venue; shared free-weight/bodyweight fallback is labeled as shared, while machines cannot borrow other venues' histories. Unconfirmed raw history stays visible without charts or inferred units; a convention change opens a venue-specific baseline.

dos: Do preserve the compact inherited identity and preview-local tokens.
Do retain setup/date provenance and blank references for unidentified gear.
Do keep choices temporary and distinguish proposals from active training.
Do show missing RIR distinctly from zero and preserve incomplete entries for review.
donts: Don't share the installed app database/cache, rewrite imported history, or expose real data outside the isolated review installation.
Don't treat this record as approval to change the public tracker, active v1.7 program or CSVs.
Don't assume the real TTL preacher plate convention; total/per-arm meaning remains unconfirmed.
